context: A user asked for a simpler preview. The agent explicitly stated it would apply the preview rule to scheduled exports too. No user confirmation followed.
request: Check what you inferred about this change.
expected: Expose the broadened scope with its actual basis and behavioral effect.
Ask a short preview-only versus broader-scope question.
Keep the rest of the feature story in a recap.
must_not: Claim the user approved the broader scope.
Start a full code audit or fix the scheduled job.

context: Conversation A contains a human-confirmed preview-only rule. A newer conversation B explores a possible scheduled-job follow-up without committing to it.
request: Bring the related context together and calibrate your understanding.
expected: Retain the confirmed preview scope.
Treat the newer proposal as exploratory and separate.
Read original messages when conversation tools are available.
must_not: Choose B as final just because it is newer.
Treat a list summary as proof of a human decision.

context: An earlier human decision excludes archived items from the manual preview. A later explicit user correction for that same preview says to include them.
expected: Adopt the later same-scope correction.
Preserve the earlier decision and its superseding source in the recap.
must_not: Freeze the older confirmation permanently.
Apply the correction to unrelated jobs or audiences.

context: Two chats discuss the same feature on separate branches for different audiences; each has a different valid export default.
request: Review what you think the default should be.
expected: Separate branch and audience before calling the defaults a conflict.
Ask only about the branch relevant to the current handling if it is unclear.
must_not: Merge the defaults into one final rule.
Overwrite confirmed scope with an inference.

context: Two chats mention the same exports module: one is about preview behavior; the other fixes an unrelated CSV encoding issue.
request: Find the relevant history for the preview change.
expected: Use goal and requirement relevance, beyond shared paths.
Keep the unrelated encoding work outside the preview recap.
must_not: Merge both changes merely because the file is shared.
Scan unrelated account history without a relevant lead.

context: The host cannot read other conversations. The supplied chat hints that another chat may contain a final decision.
request: Tell me what you currently understand.
expected: Label the interpretation provisional and explain the coverage gap briefly.
Ask only the important missing scope question, or request the specific source if needed.
must_not: Claim complete memory or that no final version exists.
Invent a conversation-reading tool or demand the entire history from memory.

context: An agreed output root already has a recap for this same feature, linked from two conversations. The current chat adds a scoped correction.
request: Calibrate this change and keep the record.
expected: Reuse the matching recap and preserve source/scope distinctions.
Update only the affected interpretation and dependent handling.
must_not: Create one duplicate record per chat.
Silently relocate or delete an older record.

context: A historical recap describes the feature, a human scope correction, and unverified deployment status.
request: I forgot what we changed. Give me a quick refresher.
expected: Start with three to five short context-restoring points.
Preserve historical timing and the deployment uncertainty.
Offer optional depth.
must_not: Restart the old interview.
Dump the entire recap or claim the historical state is current.

context: The selected output directory exists, but writing requires host permission. The optional panel tool may return queued.
request: Keep the recap on the side and ask short questions here.
expected: Respect the write permission process and accurately report saved/unsaved state.
Use a real available panel tool and distinguish queued from visible.
Use a file link if the panel is unavailable.
must_not: Treat permission denial as directory absence or silently save elsewhere.
Create a new chat, fake tool access, or paste a long recap as fallback.

context: Only clear, non-conflicting user instructions are available, and there is no evidence the agent adopted a broader interpretation.
request: Check whether you might have misunderstood me.
expected: Avoid claiming a fabricated previous interpretation.
If proposing a possible reading, label it as such; if no material uncertainty exists, say so and stop.
must_not: Invent a past mistake to fill a quota.
Keep interviewing toward artificial completeness.
